entry.title: New: dsh-telegram-channel
entry.summary: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies. Exact install spec: github:hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
